levels.gapfill.offset_max_m.note: moving median of the 505 DAHITI - Hydroweb pairs within +/-20 d, window +/-730.5 d around each scene (>= 20 pairs, else the nearest 20)

levels.gapfill.offset_median_m.note: median over gap-filled scenes of the moving-median offset applied; moving median of the 505 DAHITI - Hydroweb pairs within +/-20 d, window +/-730.5 d around each scene (>= 20 pairs, else the nearest 20)

levels.gapfill.offset_min_m.note: moving median of the 505 DAHITI - Hydroweb pairs within +/-20 d, window +/-730.5 d around each scene (>= 20 pairs, else the nearest 20)

levels.gapfill.offset_sigma_p50_m.note: median over gap-filled scenes of the common offset 1-sigma (SE of the moving median and the window-local tau); tau(t) = max(local, record-wide): local = method-of-moments excess over the years whose middle pair time is within +/-730.5 d of the scene (at least 5 years, else the nearest 5); offset 1-sigma = sqrt(SE_moving_median^2 + tau^2), common to the gap-filled scenes, added after interpolation

levels.gapfill.offset_sigma_p50_record_t.note: the same with the record-wide tau instead (superseded; first D-020 correction)

levels.gapfill.resid_nmad_m.note: NMAD of the pair differences about the moving median (per-record random term)

levels.gapfill.tau_m.note: record-wide (all years pooled) year-to-year offset variability beyond sampling noise (method of moments); the floor of the applied tau, not the applied value (see levels.gapfill.tau_p50_m)

levels.gapfill.tau_min_years.note: minimum number of years in the local tau window

levels.gapfill.tau_p50_m.note: median over gap-filled scenes of the applied window-local tau; tau(t) = max(local, record-wide): local = method-of-moments excess over the years whose middle pair time is within +/-730.5 d of the scene (at least 5 years, else the nearest 5); offset 1-sigma = sqrt(SE_moving_median^2 + tau^2), common to the gap-filled scenes, added after interpolation

levels.hydroweb_noise_floor_m.note: Hydroweb record noise with q fixed to the DAHITI estimate

levels.max_gap_days.note: gap rule: caspian.levels default fixed in commit aabacee before PREREG v1.0 and before the DAHITI data arrived; not in PREREG v1.0; stated for the record in PREREG Amendment 4 item 2 (D-038)

levels.q_m2_per_day.note: effective diffusion of the linear-interpolation error (absorbs sub-sampling variability); joint estimate with q from cross-validated interpolation residuals (D-018 correction)
